description: Default-point EB-threshold ablation on the current canonical mechanism. Every arm uses target utilisation 0.5, denominator 16, K=10, and the same corrected fee semantics; only ebThresholdBytes changes. The half-RB arm is the recommended configuration, the 1-byte arm measures the effect of gating, and the quarter/three-quarter-RB arms measure threshold sensitivity. Run across the five headline loads with paired seeds and independent random streams.
